agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9, 2020 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 19, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session, August 19, 2020 Regular Meeting, August 20, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session, August 26, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session, and August 26, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-09-09 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-09-09 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Second Reading and Adoption of City of Encinitas Ordinance 2020-14 prohibiting jumping or diving from bridges and beach stairway accesses into the ocean or waterways in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: Lifeguard Captain Giles
Adopt Ordinance 2020-14 titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending Chapter 8.08 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Prohibiting Jumping and Diving from Public Structures into the Ocean and Waterways.”
2020-09-09 Item 08C Adoption of Bridge Jumping Ordinance
8D.
Second reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 2020-13 for amendments to Title 11 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to prohibit the sale and distribution of flavored tobacco products in the City of Encinitas and increase the minimum age in accordance with new Federal law. Contact Person: Planner IV Zornes
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2020-13 titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 11 (Health) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Prohibit the Sale and Distribution of Flavored Tobacco Products in the City of Encinitas.”
2020-09-09 Item 08D Adoption of Flavored Tobacco Prohibition Ordinance
8E.
Award of contract to Civic Solutions, Inc. for planning services, in an amount not-to-exceed $166,970 and authorize the City Manager to enter into a Professional Services Agreement for said services. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc., for planning services in an amount not-to-exceed $166,970 in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report.
2020-09-09 Item 08E Civic Solutions Contract
8F.
Approval of plans and specifications and authorization to advertise for bids the MacKinnon Avenue Americans with Disability Act (ADA) Sidewalk Improvements (CS20D) Project. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Kirk
Approve the plans and specifications, and authorize advertisement for bids for the MacKinnon Avenue ADA Sidewalk Improvements (CS20D) Project.
2020-09-09 Item 08F Authorization to advertise the MacKinnon Avenue Sidewalk Improvements Project CS20D
8G.
Notice of Completion for the Moonlight State Beach Playground Replacement Project # PR-RFB-19-05 (REBID). Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report.
2020-09-09 Item 08G NOC for the Moonlight State Beach Playground Replacement Project
8H.
Authorization to award a Two-Year Agreement for Managed Print Services. Contact Person: IT Project Manager Salmon
1) Approve upgrading the City of Encinitas hardware printer/scanner fleet and software through managed print services; and 2) Authorize the Interim City Manager to enter into a Managed Print Services contract with Kyocera Document Solutions, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report for a not-to-exceed amount of $63,000 in FY 2020-21 and a not-to-exceed amount of $56,000 in FY 2021-22. Staff is also requesting a 15-percent contingency in the amount of $9,450 in FY 2020-21 for a project total not to exceed $128,450. The pricing includes vendor participation in NASPO ValuePoint Cooperative Agreement #140599, California Participating Addendum #7-19-70-46-04.
2020-09-09 Item 08H Managed Print Services
8I.
Authorization to procure VMWare software and annual support maintenance. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
Authorize the procurement of VMWare VRealize in an amount of $40,144 in FY 2020-21 and corresponding maintenance and support in the amount of $49,820 in FY 2020-21 for a total amount not-to-exceed $179,948 for the term September 15, 2020 to June 30, 2023 using the NASPO ValuePoint (AR2472) (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) and California Participating Addendum No 7-17-70-40 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report) contract pricing through Nth Generation Computing.
2020-09-09 Item 08I VMWare Software and Annual Support Maintenance
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Second reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 2020-15 amending Title 6 and Title 15 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to identify the City Manager, or designee, as the Issuing Authority for specific Operations Permits and to implement a Sidewalk Vending Operations Program; adoption of Resolution 2020-66 establishing a Sidewalk Vending Operations Permit Policy regulating the time, place and manner of sidewalk vending operations in the City of Encinitas in compliance with Senate Bill 946 (Government Code sections 51036-51039), in the interest of protecting the public health, safety and welfare; and adoption of Resolution 2020-76 establishing permit and renewal fees for Sidewalk Vending Operations Permits. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2020-15 titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Titles 6 and 15 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Issuing Authority for Operations Permits and Implementing a Sidewalk Vending Operations Program” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-66 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting a Sidewalk Vending Operations Permit Policy” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-76 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting a Sidewalk Vending Operations Permit Fee and Renewal Fee” (Attachment 3 of the agenda report).
2020-09-09 Item 10A Sidewalk Vending Ordinance & Policies
10B.
Subcommittee Recommendation for New City Manager’s Appointment and Employment Agreement. Contact Persons: Mayor Blakespear & Council Member Mosca
1) Consider Resolution 2020-79 appointing Pamela W. Antil as City Manager and authorizing the Mayor to execute the Employment Agreement, effective October 12, 2020, at an annual base compensation of $250,000 and an annual City contribution of $15,000 to a 401a deferred compensation plan; and 2) Consider Resolution 2020-81 approving and adopting the City Manager Pay Schedule in the amount of $250,000.
2020-09-09 Item 10B City Manager Appointment and Employment Agreement
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON SEPTEMBER 16, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
